data.name: Mariska
data.gender_notes: Mariska is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Slavic name Mara, meaning 'bitter', and the suffix -iska, meaning 'little'. The name Mariska can be interpreted as 'Little Martyr'. In Christian tradition, this name is associated with the martyr Saint Mariscalia, who was a young girl martyred in Spain during the Roman persecutions. The name Mariska carries the meaning “Little Martyr” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Mariska usually hope their child will grow to embody little martyr and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of courage and faith in the face of adversity.
data.etymology: Mariska belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Little Martyr.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mariska total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

data.spiritual_significance: Mariska's name has a profound spiritual significance for Christians. The moniker 'Little Martyr' symbolizes the call to follow in the footsteps of Christ and His saints, which involves denying oneself and embracing the Cross with courage and dedication. By giving their lives in the service of God, these martyrs remind us of the greatest act of love and sacrifice. Therefore, wearing the name Mariska as a Christian can be considered a constant reminder of the importance of faith, martyrdom, and the ultimate sacrifice.
